title: Accelerating voltage expression
description: Essential Criteria: The final answer for part (1) must be correctly expressed as U = mE²/(2eB²) or an equivalent form derived from force balance and energy.

title: Force balance reasoning
description: Important Criteria: The solution must apply the condition eE = evB for the electron's straight-line motion when both fields are present.

title: Energy from accelerating voltage
description: Important Criteria: The solution must relate the kinetic energy gained to the accelerating voltage using eU = (1/2)mv².

title: Work by electric force
description: Essential Criteria: The final answer for part (2) must be correctly expressed as W = (e²L²B²)/(2m) or an equivalent form.

title: Kinematics for deflection
description: Important Criteria: For part (2), the solution must correctly apply kinematics (e.g., y = (1/2)at² with a = eE/m) to find the vertical displacement.

title: Work calculation method
description: Important Criteria: For part (2), the work done must be calculated via W = eEy, linking the vertical displacement to the electric force.

title: Time of flight relation
description: Optional Criteria: The solution may explicitly state the horizontal motion relation L = vt to connect time with other variables.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize incorrect sign handling for the electron's charge in force or work equations (e.g., using +e instead of -e magnitude).

title: Unit inconsistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize answers with inconsistent or missing units where they are required, or dimensional errors in derived expressions.
